span.label: mechanisms
span.term: each hippocampal segment inherits its functional repertoire from the set of regions it is structurally and functionally wired to, so a segment connected to limbic, prefrontal, temporal and parietal cortex can carry out a correspondingly diverse set of cognitive processes
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: the parcellation inherits the composition of its input database, and because BrainMap over-represents cognition-based studies the right hippocampus is left without a clean cluster solution
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the anterior portion is proposed to handle limbic or hot processing and the posterior spatial navigation and learned associations, a division carried over from rodent dorsal and ventral axes
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the right hippocampus may be functionally heterogeneous, which is offered as the reason its cluster solution is less stable

span.label: or the right hippocampus may not be organised by behavioural or stimulus features at all, so that its topography is a gradient rather than a set of parts

span.label: posterior segments connect to the posterior cingulate, a default mode hub, which is read as support for an internal attention account

span.label: The left hippocampus divides into three anterior-to-posterior clusters: an emotional cluster tied to amygdala and parahippocampal gyrus, a cognitive cluster tied to anterior cingulate and inferior frontal gyrus, and a posterior perceptual cluster tied to occipital lobe, precuneus and angular gyrus.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The right hippocampus does not yield one clear parcellation: both a 2-cluster and a 5-cluster solution remain plausible.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The anterior-most left cluster was behaviourally characterised by face monitoring/discrimination, cued explicit recall and encoding.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The middle left cluster was characterised by paired associate recall, cued explicit recognition and encoding.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The behavioural labels attached to the right-hippocampal clusters failed FDR correction, so they are reported only with caution.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Diffusion tractography showed the posterior left cluster connecting to the occipital lobe, specifically lingual gyrus and occipital pole, alongside parahippocampal, posterior cingulate and amygdala connections.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Interhemispheric structural connections increase toward the posterior end of both left and right hippocampus.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Left and right hippocampus produce different clustering profiles, which the authors read as evidence of hemispheric lateralization.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The data support a hot-to-cold anterior-posterior gradient but depart from it in one respect: anterior right-hemisphere portions are also engaged in "cold" processing.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the left hippocampus divided into three segments running anterior to posterior, associated with faces and recall, with paired associate recall and recognition, and with perception
